title: Finite element approximation for a reformulation of a 3D fluid-2D plate interaction system
summary: We study a finite element approximation of a coupled fluid-structure interaction consisting of a three-dimensional incompressible viscous fluid governed by the unsteady Stokes equations and a two-dimensional elastic plate. To avoid the use of $H^2-$conforming or nonconforming $\mathbb{P}_2$-Morley plate elements, the fourth-order plate equation is reformulated into a system of coupled second-order equations using an auxiliary variable.
